Texas Global
Texas Global advances UT Austin’s international engagement efforts. From forging partnerships on campus and abroad, to providing transformational study abroad opportunities, to supporting international students and scholars on campus, Texas Global is the University’s gateway to the world.
Texas Global
International Student and Scholar Services (ISSS)
ISSS supports international students in adjusting to life on the Forty Acres. This unit handles visas and immigration support services such and insurance and financial aid, and provides myriad opportunities for social activity and connection. Once you’ve been admitted to UT Austin, ISSS will introduce you to your new life in Texas.
ISSS
TOEFL/IELTS/DET Information
International applicants must submit either an official Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL), International English Language Testing System (IELTS) or Duolingo English Test (DET) demonstrating an adequate knowledge of English. We cannot accept institutional TOEFL (ITP) scores, TOEFL Essentials scores or IELTS General Training scores.
International applicants are exempt from this requirement if they:
Are from a qualifying country, or
Graduate from a high school in the United States or a qualifying country after completing at least three years of study.
Minimum scores acceptable for admission are:
TOEFL: 79 (120 scale) or 4 (6-point scale) internet-based test
IELTS: An overall band of 6.5 on the Academic Examination
DET: 115 minimum overall score
TOEFL IELTS DET
Qualifying Countries
For purposes of the TOEFL or IELTS requirement, international applicants are exempt only if they are from a country where English is the sole official language and the primary conversational language of the country. In some countries, English is but one of the officially recognized languages or it is not the primary language used to communicate outside of the classroom.
Students from the following countries are exempt from the TOEFL/IELTS requirement:
American Samoa
Australia
Bahamas
Barbados
Belize
Canada (except Quebec)
Dominica
Ghana
Grenada
Grand Cayman
Guyana
India
Ireland
Jamaica
Kenya
Liberia
New Zealand
Nigeria
Singapore
Trinidad/Tobago
Turks and Caicos Islands
United Kingdom
U.S. Pacific Trust
Submitting Scores
The University’s TOEFL code is 6882. There is no institutional code for the IELTS or DET examination. To fulfill the requirement with scores from the IELTS, please use the IELTS electronic score delivery service to send your scores to the “University of Texas at Austin” account. To send your scores to DET, select “University of Texas at Austin – Undergraduate Admissions”.
